svg.aria-label: One grammar, a .sxir file, enters the SyntaxIR core, which checks its cost and safety, optimizes it through a multi-stage IR into typed, incremental and streaming parsers, and provides a full toolchain: a language server, lint, trace, profile and fuzzing. It compiles to generated Go, generated TypeScript, the bytecode VM and WebAssembly in the browser; more targets are on the roadmap.
